answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the pearl of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, re-queued for a second panel, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The oasis holds work receipts rather than names, so the cedar of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short.
